title: Solution treatment of stainless fittings and flanges: 7 tonnes including the basket, immersed within 50 seconds
summary: This 420 kW electric fork-handling furnace solution-treats stainless fittings and flanges. After soaking, the car transfers a 7-tonne loaded basket to the tank. The specified time from first outward movement to complete immersion is at most 50 seconds.
seoTitle: Quenching a 7-tonne basket of pipe fittings and flanges
seoDescription: The agreement includes basket weight in its 7-tonne limit. See the 420 kW furnace and the 50-second transfer criterion for full immersion.

forkReview.note: The 7 tonnes includes the heat-resistant basket and excludes support blocks. Subtract the empty basket weight to obtain net fitting weight.
features: The basket carries the entire batch
Load the fittings or flanges into a heat-resistant steel basket and heat them together. All protruding elbows and stacked flanges must remain within the working envelope.
The car transfers the loaded basket
The forks support the basket underneath. After soaking, withdraw it, align it with the tank and lower it. Time from the first outward movement until the last part is fully immersed.

stages.title: Load the basket
stages.note: The basket and its contents weigh 7 tonnes in total.

stages.title: Charge the basket
stages.note: The basket enters the working zone, which has two heating zones.

stages.title: Withdraw the basket
stages.note: Support the basket underneath. Start timing when the fittings begin to move out.

stages.title: Immerse the batch
stages.note: Stop the clock when the last workpiece is fully under water.

head: Item
Project specification
rows: RX4-420-11 rapid solution-treatment resistance chamber furnace
7 tonnes including basket and parts. Maximum withdrawal-to-immersion time: 50 seconds.

cards.title: Supply responsibilities
definitions: Supplies the furnace, fork car, drives and controls and carries out installation and commissioning.
Supplies the heat-resistant basket and solution-treatment water tank and prepares the site using the foundation information.

cards.title: Scope of supply
paragraphs: Suneng supplies the resistance-heated solution furnace, door lift, fork charging car and controls. The buyer’s basket carries the same load across the hearth supports, forks and water tank.

cards.title: Acceptance procedure
definitions: After manufacture, both parties check fabrication, assembly, safety and associated equipment under the agreement.
Once the empty-furnace test is satisfactory, proceed to heat under load. Acceptance requires meeting the main contract specifications.

figure.caption: 1.8 × 1.8 × 1.2 m available for the loaded basket. The stated load includes the parts and the basket. Time from first outward movement until the last workpiece is submerged.

forkReview.faqIntro: Loaded basket weight, maximum stacking height and responsibilities for the equipment.
faq: Can it hold 7 net tonnes of pipe fittings?
The 7 tonnes includes the basket. Deduct its empty weight to obtain the net weight of fittings.
How high can the basket be loaded?
The working height is 1.2 m, with a length and width of 1.8 m each. Include stacked flanges and protruding elbows when measuring the loaded basket.
Does the same party supply the furnace, basket and tank?
Suneng supplies the solution furnace and fork charging car. The buyer supplies the heat-resistant basket and water tank.
forkReview.source: Reference: 2017 purchase contract and technical agreement for the rapid solution-treatment resistance chamber furnace. The load and transfer interval follow Suneng’s published product information.
